title: Schema and Marker model: optional beat on warp markers; regenerate the contract
description:
## Intent
The stored form of your warp markers.

## Scope
- `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json`: `annotations.markers.items.beat` (number), described as "present only on warp markers (name `warp`): the beat this second is pinned to; two or more of yours replace rhythm.warp_markers". The name/beat rule and ordering are checked in code (JSON Schema cannot), and the description says so.
- `web/amplify/data/resource.ts`: `Marker.beat: a.float()`; regenerate `contract/` (`web/scripts/generate-contract.ts`), check mode clean. Coordinate with the storage initiative (apricitus-e70662) before merging; this is a contract version change.
- Schema tests: Rust (`crates/apricity-score/tests`, validates fixture manifests) and `analysis/tests/test_manifests.py` (new cases).

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-score` · `PYTHONPATH=analysis analysis/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q analysis/tests/test_manifests.py` · `npx --prefix web tsx web/scripts/generate-contract.ts --check`.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): warp markers of yours in the manifest and the Marker model` (not breaking).

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
